claim_boundary.reason: This is an engineering parity and throughput test of gas-phase conformer evaluation. It does not improve or validate the PB/GB solvent functional and does not compare against bare molecular mechanics.

decision_boundary.interpretation: Numerical equivalence admits the common batch interface. The failed all-model speed gate separately forbids a universal material-speedup claim; speed evidence remains backend-specific.

threshold_basis.accuracy: The absolute-energy gate is 0.001 kcal/mol converted to Hartree; the relative-energy and propagated-delta-G gates are also 0.001 kcal/mol. These are approximately 0.0017 kBT at 298.15 K and are far below the accuracy scale claimed for the solvent model; they guard numerical equivalence rather than fit chemistry.
threshold_basis.pilot_disclosure: A one-case exploratory timing pilot selected the common batch size. The relative-energy, propagated-delta-G, and 1.25x speed gates were fixed before the initial 19-case run. Review of that run exposed missing absolute-energy admission, warmup, provenance, and fail-closed decision checks. Protocol v2 therefore adds an absolute-energy gate equal to the existing 0.001 kcal/mol tolerance converted to Hartree and repairs those runner contracts before a confirmatory full rerun. The v2 rerun is review-amended confirmation, not a wholly pre-data protocol.
threshold_basis.speed: A fixed batch size of 16 is used for every model. The 1.25x floor requires material acceleration after including structure construction, graph building, and result splitting.
